meta.description: Annual probability of death q_x by country, calendar year and exact age, both sexes combined. Values are integers in millionths (q = value / 1e6). Index = (year - first_year) * ages + age.
meta.age_100_note: Index 100 is the open 100+ interval: a low-confidence GAME ESTIMATE extrapolated from the q98-q99 logit trend, not a WPP value.
meta.source: United Nations, DESA, Population Division. World Population Prospects 2024 (MORT/F04 life-table survivors at exact age), both sexes.
meta.license: CC BY 3.0 IGO. Modified: q_x = 1 - l(x+1)/l(x) derived by the spec package; compacted here.
meta.scope_note: National period life tables. NOT measured rates for the named city.
